## RunEnv.inflight property

the loads in flight, from `createInflight`<!-- -->: one object per process, given to every run. Two  runs that ask the same loader key at once (the same cache entry) load it once, the second  waiting for the first's answer; a run that stops waits no more, and the load goes on for the  others. Default: each run loads what its cache misses

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly inflight?: Inflight;
```
